observations.classification: nonblocking observation; no M03 repair requested
observations.case: Use the current studio Export lighting plan menu and choose Share text settings.
observations.title: Shared plain text does not carry report/scene versions
observations.evidence: The complete plainText body omits reportVersion and scene.schemaVersion. This string is produced by StudioView.exportText (1161–1162), passed to LightingPlanExportMenu at 399, and shared by LightingPlanExportFlow at 73–78. PDF base() separately includes both versions at LightingPlanPDF.swift:53.
observations.impact: Standalone text lacks format/schema provenance that the PDF carries; numerical settings and units remain present.
observations.scope: The general product workflow mentions version-bearing exports, but current M03 acceptance does not expressly require this text metadata. Do not infer an M03 failure or expand M05 scope.
observations.possible_future_action: Consider matching PDF version metadata when undertaking export-text maintenance, with a presence assertion.

observations.classification: nonblocking observation; no M03 repair requested
observations.case: Share text settings for a no-room scene with lights at positive and negative X/Z positions.
observations.title: Shared plain-text header does not explicitly state X/Z orientation
observations.evidence: The header defines XYZ units and Y elevation and supplies both subject and camera positions, but omits +X/+Z orientation wording. The PDF overview explicitly supplies +X right/+Z down/Y elevation at LightingPlanPDF.swift:93. The optional room section separately defines wall-relative coordinates and positive rotation.
observations.impact: A reader using standalone text must infer the world orientation from scene/camera context or external conventions. This is narrower than asserting the numerical coordinates are wrong; all signed values remain present at the disclosed rounding precision.
observations.scope: No current M03 acceptance violation or demonstrated broken workflow was established. Current PDF already supplies the convention; no PDF fix or M05 expansion is requested.
observations.possible_future_action: Consider explicit authored-world direction wording if export text is revised, carefully qualifying the initial/default-camera +Z convention.
